brief_summary: Side-by-side cross-section comparing a dense, solid-shaded aluminum gasket case (labeled heft, resonant low end) against the Ikki68 Aurora's hatched, translucent polycarbonate gasket case (labeled lighter, bouncier, glow-diffusing). Both sides show the same floating gasket-mounted plate to isolate the shell material as the variable.
data_sources: apps/web/src/content/articles/aurora-glow-theme-build.mdx § 'The tradeoff the PC case is making, honestly' — 'Aluminum gasket boards in the same bracket carry more mass and a denser shell, which tends to read as deeper resonance and more of the low thock... The Aurora's PC shell, combined with its gasket mount, produces a softer, bouncier keystroke instead.'
